name: Козятин
_about: Town of Козятин (Хмільницький р-н, Вінницька обл.). CITY ONLY. Russian official name: Казатин.
_endings: Masculine -ин town: case endings are ENUMERATED, not stem+\p{L}{0,2}. Two free letters would reach the plural demonym (-ці), the feminine demonym (-ка) and neighbouring villages named <town>ка. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-01-multi-town-design.md.

excluded._why: Share the stem but are not the town.
excluded._acceptedCollision: Villages also named Козятин exist in Сумська (Охтирка) and Волинська oblasts. Identical spelling, cannot be separated lexically. None seen in a 204-post corpus. Accepted.
